reason: The report's 'no effect' conclusion rests on a north-only, outcome-trimmed subsample (N=634) chosen without justification. On the full sample of 2000 firms, with the same controls including pre-period export growth, the coefficient is about 0.69 (SE 0.24, p=0.004), and it is similar with all the pre-period controls added. The controls themselves are pre-period, but the subsample selection reverses the conclusion.
